research.mariculture.aquamancy.stage_0:
Water carries more than fish. Tanks filled with the right brine, fed the right reagents and kept near the right light breed creatures that hold aspects in their scales. Pearls, salt and neoprene take to the crucible, and Thaumaturge metals melt in the crucible furnace like any other.
The branches of this tab cover alchemy from the sea, warded diving gear, molten magical metals and the six magical fish.
research.mariculture.aquamancy.title: Aquamancy
research.mariculture.auramfin.stage_0: Vis crystals dissolve slowly in water and the fish that swim near them grow fins that taste of aura.
research.mariculture.auramfin.stage_1: A Wisp Angler and an Electric Ray bred in Brine of Order and fed vis crystals can give an Auramfin. It drops aer and auram crystals, and a tank holding one slowly puts vis back into the aura.
research.mariculture.auramfin.title: Auramfin
research.mariculture.brine_of_order.stag: Salis mundus scattered on water settles into an orderly brine.
The vat mixes a bucket of water with salis mundus into Brine of Order. The six magical fish breed only in a fish tank filled with it, and only for a tank owner who has finished their research entry.
research.mariculture.eldritch_gulper.sta: An eldritch eye still watches after it is cut loose. Something in liquid ender would want to look back.

A Flux Lamprey and an Enderfish bred in Brine of Order and fed an eldritch eye can give an Eldritch Gulper. It lives in liquid ender, bites whatever reaches into its tank, and drops alienis crystals and eldritch eyes.
research.mariculture.fish_rendering.stag: Raw fish carries plenty of flesh and life for alchemy.
Raw fish in the crucible renders into two fish chunks. The fish feeder also takes Thaumaturge meat chunks, brains and tallow as fish food.
research.mariculture.flux_lamprey.stage_: Tainted goo spreads in brackish water. A lamprey fed on it would feed on flux as well.

An Auramfin and a Lamprey bred in Brine of Order and fed tainted goo can give a Flux Lamprey. It likes brackish water, drops vitium crystals and tainted goo, and eats flux from the aura around its tank.
research.mariculture.flux_lamprey.title: Flux Lamprey
research.mariculture.mask_of_revealing.s: Goggles of Revealing show aspects and aura. A scuba mask has the same lenses, only wetter.
Infusing a scuba mask with Goggles of Revealing gives the mask their sight. It shows aspects, aura and flux like the goggles do and still works as a scuba mask.
research.mariculture.molten_thaumium.sta: Thaumium melts like any other metal, only hotter.
The crucible furnace melts thaumium nuggets, ingots and blocks at 1400 degrees. The ingot, nugget and block casters cast molten thaumium back into metal.
research.mariculture.molten_void.stage_0: Void metal pulls at whatever holds it. Melting it should be done with care.
research.mariculture.molten_void.stage_1: The crucible furnace melts void metal at 1600 degrees, and the casters turn molten void into nuggets, ingots and blocks. Handling it for long leaves a mark on the mind.
research.mariculture.molten_void.title: Molten Void
research.mariculture.pearl_alchemy.stage: Pearls hold a little order and a lot of water. A pearl held in the hand shows how much the crucible could pull out of one.
A pearl oyster dropped into the crucible splits into two. A pearl of any colour dissolves into a drop of quicksilver.
research.mariculture.pearl_alchemy.title: Pearl Alchemy
research.mariculture.quicksilver_eel.sta: Quicksilver sinks through water and pools in hot places. A fish that lived in it would need lava to stay warm.
A Wisp Angler and a Blazefish bred in Brine of Order and fed quicksilver can give a Quicksilver Eel. It lives in lava or brine and drops quicksilver nuggets.
research.mariculture.sea_salts.stage_0: Salt is dried sea, and the sea remembers where it came from. Scanning salt shows the order locked inside it.
research.mariculture.sea_salts.stage_1: Salt in the crucible multiplies into four. Limestone breaks down into ancient sand, the old seabed that the sifter picks through.
research.mariculture.sea_salts.title: Sea Salts
research.mariculture.sifting_ancient_san: The sifter now turns up more from ancient sand than shells and bones. With Thaumaturge installed it also finds amber and quicksilver nuggets, buried where old reefs once grew.
research.mariculture.thaumium_trout.stag: Thaumium flakes off in water. A trout that ate enough of it would carry the metal in its scales.

A Quicksilver Eel and a Rainbow Trout bred in Brine of Order and fed thaumium nuggets can give a Thaumium Trout. It drops thaumium nuggets and sometimes a droplet of molten thaumium for the liquifier.
research.mariculture.treated_neoprene.st: Neoprene keeps water out. Studying a sheet shows how a little warding would make it keep out much more.
Neoprene in the crucible doubles into two sheets.
research.mariculture.unlock_aquamancy.st: Some fish carry more than meat. Scanning a live fish shows a faint trace of magic under the scales.
A live fish in hand opens the Aquamancy tab.
A scuba suit keeps a diver dry. Infused with salis mundus, thaumium and prismarine it can do much more.
The runic matrix wards a scuba suit, scuba mask or swimfins without changing what they already do. A diver wearing all three warded pieces loses no breath underwater and swims faster.
research.mariculture.wisp_angler.stage_0: Nitor gives off a light that some deep fish follow. A Stargazer and a Lanternjaw kept together in brine might take to it.
research.mariculture.wisp_angler.stage_1: A Stargazer and a Lanternjaw bred in Brine of Order and fed nitor can give a Wisp Angler. It needs bright light and drops lux crystals and glowstone.
research.mariculture.wisp_angler.title: Wisp Angler
